# UX Requirements Checklist: Low-Resource Reliable macOS Audio

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for user-facing route status, readiness truthfulness, accessibility, recovery guidance, and non-recording clarity before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-06-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. Items test the requirements and design artifacts, not the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are user-facing route states complete for idle-safe, starting, ready, active, stale, blocked, failed, retrying, and fallback? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Data Model §Audio Resource State]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for distinguishing virtual device visibility from live-route readiness in UI and diagnostics? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Contract §Readiness Planes]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for communicating that passthrough can be active while recording/transcription remains off? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Spec §Visible Control Impact]
- [x] CHK004 Are recovery action requirements complete for stale heartbeat, Core Audio restart, sleep/wake, invalid physical device, and fallback states? [Completeness, Spec §US3, Data Model §App Bridge Health Evidence]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Are labels such as "ready", "active", "stale", "blocked", "failed", and "idle-safe" clear enough to avoid implying recording or capture? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Data Model §Audio Resource State]
- [x] CHK006 Is the user expectation for automatic activation without `Run Check` clear across idle, startup, and blocked states? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK007 Are blocked and failed states described with enough specificity to support truthful user guidance rather than generic "not ready" copy? [Clarity, Spec §US2, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK008 Are requirements clear that a visible virtual microphone/speaker is not enough to show the route as ready? [Clarity, Spec §SC-013, Contract §Readiness Planes]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Are UX state requirements consistent with the visible fail-closed device policy and not with older surprise-hide behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023, Contract §Visibility Rules]
- [x] CHK010 Are readiness/status requirements consistent across UI, diagnostics, quickstart, and validation evidence artifacts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Data Model §Route Truth Snapshot, Quickstart §Route Truth Diagnostics Gate]
- [x] CHK011 Are UX requirements consistent with brand-distance and original 2brain Rec language expectations? [Consistency, Spec §UX/Brand/Accessibility Impact]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK012 Are UX success criteria measurable for clearing ready UI within 5 seconds after restart, sleep/wake, or device change? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK013 Are UX acceptance criteria measurable for no-Run-Check regression coverage and automatic readiness behavior? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-018]
- [x] CHK014 Can readiness truthfulness be objectively evaluated from the required evidence planes? [Measurability, Spec §SC-013, Contract §Readiness Planes]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK015 Are UX requirements defined for the primary path where a browser or meeting app starts using virtual devices from idle-safe state? [Coverage, Spec §US1]
- [x] CHK016 Are UX requirements defined for exception paths where startup exceeds 3 seconds, Core Audio is unhealthy, or physical devices are invalid? [Coverage, Spec §US2, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Are UX requirements defined for recovery paths after `coreaudiod` restart, sleep/wake, stale browser device IDs, and app bridge heartbeat loss? [Coverage, Spec §US3, Data Model §App Bridge Health Evidence]
- [x] CHK018 Are UX requirements defined for self-routing and unsupported virtual/aggregate/multi-output device selections? [Coverage, Spec §US5, Spec §FR-024]

## Accessibility And Localization

- [x] CHK019 Are accessibility requirements specified for keyboard reachability, non-color-only status, and readable state changes? [Coverage, Spec §UX/Brand/Accessibility Impact]
- [x] CHK020 Are localization-safe copy requirements defined for status labels, recovery actions, and diagnostics summaries? [Gap, Spec §UX/Brand/Accessibility Impact]
- [x] CHK021 Are requirements defined for avoiding audio-status language that could be misunderstood as active capture or recording? [Clarity, Spec §Visible Control Impact, Spec §FR-015]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK022 Is the relationship between `Run Check`, automatic activation, readiness evidence, and future health checks unambiguous? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK023 Are "Not ready", "blocked", "stale", "failed", and "repair" concepts distinct enough for designers and implementers to create consistent UI? [Terminology, Spec §FR-011, Data Model §Audio Resource State]
